item.title: Alexander seeks public input on joint comprehensive plan
item.description: Press release:The Town and Village of Alexander have launched a joint Comprehensive Plan that will guide future decisions about land use, housing, recreation, public services, infrastructure, economic development, and the overall character of the community. New York Green and LaBella Associates are assisting the municipalities in developing this plan
